findings.note: Overlap with pending store rows beyond the pack list: entity-api-floor-project-repo-branch-cloning-counts, entity-api-pull-proposal-client-entity-state-draft-checks-cl and entity-api-proposal-detail-mergeable-commits-comments-review serve the same Floor/Proposal/detail surfaces, and those rows list reviewDecision / mergeable / mergeStateStatus as served fields while this story's acceptance ('no platform response carries a field named reviewDecision, mergeStateStatus or mergeable', AD-14) forbids exactly that. The author's notes cite entity-api-* only on e11-impl-pin-client-protocol, not on this story. Reconcile at backfill (supersede/adjust the entity-api-* rows) so the same routes are not built twice and the field sets do not self-contradict.

check_cmd derives entity names from interface-contract.md and requires normalized 'pr/proposal detail', while the slice scope's AD-14 parenthetical says 'Pull/Proposal detail'. Simulated a conformant section in /tmp: with 'PR / Proposal detail' the check printed 'OK: client protocol pinned (11 entities, contract v3)' exit 0; with 'Pull / Proposal detail' it printed 'FAIL: entities missing: PR / Proposal detail' exit 1. Implementers must use the interface-contract.md spelling (or include both forms); the heading regex likewise accepts only 'Client protocol'/'client protocol' (lowercase 'protocol').

Event-family gate is substring-based over the whole section: 'chat', 'queue' and 'peer' are already satisfied by the required entity rows (Chat / Notifications, Task / Queue, Presence / Peer), and 'floor.'/'term.' can be satisfied by prose, so a pass does not strictly prove all 8 event families carry push-event vocabulary. Machine check is necessary but not sufficient for that acceptance clause; keep human review on it.
